normalize_dict: normalize a Google Test JSON output dict to strip transient time and timestamp fields
normalize_list: normalize a Google Test JSON output list to strip transient time and timestamp fields
normalize_failure: normalize a Google Test JSON failure string to anonymize file paths and stack traces
normalize_nested: normalize a nested Google Test JSON object to strip all transient fields recursively
normalize_string: normalize a non-dict, non-list value by returning it unchanged
